sloka: तत् अलम् परितापेन धर्मतः परिकल्पितः ।वधो वानरशार्दूल न वयम् स्व वशे स्थिताः ॥४-१८-३५॥
transliteration: tat alam paritāpena dharmataḥ parikalpitaḥ ।vadho vānaraśārdūla na vayam sva vaśe sthitāḥ ॥4-18-35॥

translations.english: 'Vicious deeds have been committed by others when the kings were not watchful. Kings punish such sinners when they are vigilant. Otherwise they have to atone for their negligence.
